package rest

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestLanternWorkflowInterop(t *testing.T) {
	python := os.Getenv("LANTERN_INTEROP_PYTHON")
	script := os.Getenv("LANTERN_INTEROP_SCRIPT")
	if python == "" || script == "" {
		t.Skip("requires explicit isolated interoperability harness")
	}
	first := newMediaRESTFixture(t)
	second := newMediaRESTFixture(t)
	firstHTTP := httptest.NewServer(first.server.Router())
	defer firstHTTP.Close()
	secondHTTP := httptest.NewServer(second.server.Router())
	defer secondHTTP.Close()
	configuration, err := json.Marshal(map[string]string{
		"first_url": firstHTTP.URL, "second_url": secondHTTP.URL,
		"first_seed": hex.EncodeToString(first.keys["first"].Seed()),
		"second_seed": hex.EncodeToString(second.keys["second"].Seed()),
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(t.Context(), 120*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	command := exec.CommandContext(ctx, python, script)
	if runtime.GOOS == "darwin" {
		architecture := os.Getenv("LANTERN_INTEROP_ARCH")
		require.Contains(t, []string{"arm64", "x86_64"}, architecture)
		command = exec.CommandContext(ctx, "/usr/bin/arch", "-"+architecture, python, script)
	}
	command.Stdin = bytes.NewReader(configuration)
	output, err := command.CombinedOutput()
	require.NoError(t, err, string(output))
	t.Log(string(output))
	for _, fixture := range []workflowTestFixture{first, second} {
		for _, suffix := range []string{"", "-wal"} {
			path := fixture.databasePath + suffix
			content, err := os.ReadFile(path)
			if os.IsNotExist(err) && suffix == "-wal" {
				continue
			}
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.NotContains(t, string(content), "LANTERN-INTEROP-PRIVATE-CANARY", filepath.Base(path))
		}
	}
}
